title: Algorithmic trading
extract: Algorithmic trading is a method of executing orders using automated pre-programmed trading instructions accounting for variables such as time, price, and volume. This type of trading attempts to leverage the speed and computational resources of computers relative to human traders. In the 21st century, algorithmic trading has been gaining traction with both retail and institutional traders. A 2019 study showed that around 92% of trading in the Forex market was performed by trading algorithms rather than humans.
